mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form_template (form_key, kind, folder_id, origin, name, version, status, description, published_at, submitted_at, review_comment, created_by) VALUES (#{formKey}, #{kind}, #{folderId}, #{origin}, #{name}, #{version}, #{status}, #{description}, #{publishedAt}, #{submittedAt}, #{reviewComment}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM form_template ORDER BY form_key ASC, version DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM form_template WHERE kind = #{kind} ORDER BY form_key ASC, version DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM form_template WHERE form_key = #{formKey} ORDER BY version DESC
